current_sources.version_label: Annex A1, Interinstitutional Style Guide (page dated 23.1.2025)

colors.name: Reflex Blue
colors.role: Emblem rectangle (Pantone Reflex Blue; web-palette equivalent)

colors.name: Yellow
colors.role: Emblem stars (Pantone Yellow; 100% Process Yellow in four-colour)

logo_usage.background_rules: Preferably on a white background; avoid varied backgrounds or any that do not go with blue. If a coloured background is unavoidable, put a white border around the rectangle, one twenty-fifth of the rectangle height wide. Black only: outline the rectangle in black and print the stars black on white. Blue only: Reflex Blue 100% rectangle with white (negative) stars.
logo_usage.misuse: Emblem upside down; stars not upright; stars not positioned like the hours on a clock face. The number of stars (12) is fixed. Registering the emblem or an imitation as a trade mark or other IP right is not acceptable.

notes: Geometry per the guide: rectangle fly is 1.5 times the hoist; the star circle radius is one third of the hoist height; each star's points lie on a circle of one eighteenth of the hoist height. Four-colour process: Reflex Blue is approximated by 100% Process Cyan with 80% Process Magenta (Y and K not stated, so cmyk left null). No typography or minimum size is given in the guide.
